references.text: Describes the oil for the lampstand (שֶׁמֶן הַמָּאוֹר) that Eleazar was responsible for
Gives the recipe for the fragrant incense (קְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים) that Eleazar was to oversee
Describes the daily offering (מִנְחַת הַתָּמִיד) that was under Eleazar's supervision
Contains the regulation for the anointing oil (שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה) that Eleazar was responsible for
Describes the tabernacle (הַמִּשְׁכָּן) and its holy articles that Eleazar had overall supervision of
Concerns the oil for the lamps and the priest's responsibility for them
Eleazar as leader over the Levites and his responsibility for the sanctuary's articles
Describes the furnishings and holy articles of the earthly tabernacle that point forward to Christ
